requirements.statement: Connectors, MCP servers, plugins, repositories, document stores, and issue systems shall be optional capabilities with verified availability, data boundaries, health, and least-privilege permission.
requirements.verification_method: module contract tests and release traceability

requirements.statement: Retrieved external content shall be treated as untrusted data and may not redefine authority, instructions, permissions, or publication rights.
requirements.verification_method: module contract tests and release traceability

requirements.statement: Every consequential connector shall have a fallback, disable/revoke path, version pin/update policy, and recorded rollback.
requirements.verification_method: module contract tests and release traceability
